lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Hello Barbara, it's Tanya. Do you have a few minutes for our call?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Hey, yeah, I was waiting for your call.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Great. So today I'd like to hear how the bedtime goal went, check how you're feeling, and pick a goal for next week. Anything you want to add?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sounds good to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: How have you been feeling since we last talked?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay. The heat is getting to me.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So did you manage to be in bed by 10:30 on 4 nights?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Honestly, not much. Work has been crazy, I'm doing overtime.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why is this important to you right now?

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Good question.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Would it be okay if I shared something that's helped other people?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Keeping the phone out of the bedroom helps a lot of people fall asleep faster.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I feel better about myself when I stick to it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Your family is a big part of why.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Right.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're weighing it up, and that's fair.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Getting back to work is why I'm doing this. Church on Sunday always throws me off.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you think 5 days is realistic?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, yes. I got home late every day this week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: You're really honest with yourself, and that helps.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't know where the day goes. I wrote it on the calendar.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: The days got away from you.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Walking hurts my knees, so why bother.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is that something you can do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Yes. I've been watching my grandkids all week.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Is your phone in the bedroom at night?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: No, not really.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you watch TV in bed?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Sometimes.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Do you mind if I tell you what some people do?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Keeping the phone out of the bedroom helps a lot of people fall asleep faster.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I don't really see the point.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Let's put you down to be in bed by 10 on 5 nights next week.

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, how confident are you that you can do that?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Like a 6.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Why a 6 and not a 3?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Well, I have more energy when I go to bed earlier.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: What might get in the way?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: I'll do it right when I wake up, before anything else.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: So, to sum up: work made this week harder, you still got 0 days in, and your plan is to be in bed by 10 on 5 nights. Sound right?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That's it exactly.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Same time next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: That works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Talk soon!

lines.speaker: participant
lines.text: Thank you, Tanya. Bye!

flags.reason: Repeats the same phone-out-of-bedroom information verbatim after participant showed disinterest, without asking permission again.
Sets a 5-night bedtime goal directly after participant's sustain talk ('I don't really see the point'); goal not co-created.
Summary says '0 days in' though participant said 'not much'; minor misreport of progress.

score.summary: Tanya covered the full call structure and drew out good change talk, including the confidence rating and the 'do it on waking' plan. However, she repeated the same information after the participant lost interest and then set the goal without collaboration, which undercut autonomy.
strengths: Line 19 complex reflection of ambivalence ('You're weighing it up') deepened engagement.
Line 41 open question 'Why a 6 and not a 3?' elicited strong change talk.
Line 43 barrier planning question led to a concrete plan on line 44.
coaching_tips: Line 35: after the participant said 'I don't really see the point' (line 36 follows), pause and ask permission or reflect instead of repeating the same information.
Line 37: offer the goal as a choice, e.g., 'What bedtime feels doable for you next week?', rather than stating it as settled.
Line 45: summarize using the participant's own words ('not much' rather than '0 days').
